title: GenAI Innovation Soaring, With Patent Activity Nearly Tripling in Two Years
content: The generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) patent landscape has reached a new milestone, with more new patents published in 2024 and 2025 than in the entire preceding ten years combined, according to new data published today by the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO).
